description: This file defines a Python class 'StreamHixie75' for parsing and building WebSocket frames for protocol versions HyBi 00 and Hixie 75, including methods for sending/receiving messages, handling closing handshakes, and related exceptions.

classes.name: StreamHixie75
classes.description: A class for parsing and building WebSocket frames for protocol versions HyBi 00 and Hixie 75, supporting message transmission, closing handshake, and error handling.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing the StreamHixie75 instance with request and handshake options.

methods.name: send_message
methods.description: Sends a message over the WebSocket, encoding it in UTF-8 and framing with start/end bytes.

methods.name: _read_payload_length_hixie75
methods.description: Reads the payload length from a Hixie75 frame header.

methods.name: receive_message
methods.description: Receives a WebSocket message, handling frame types and closing handshakes.

methods.name: _send_closing_handshake
methods.description: Sends a closing handshake frame to terminate the connection.

methods.name: close_connection
methods.description: Closes the WebSocket connection, optionally performing a handshake.

methods.name: send_ping
methods.description: Raises exception as ping is not supported in Hixie75.
